title: 관리사무소에 요청하기: 물이 새던데 봐 주실 수 있을까요?
objective: Explain a problem with -던데 and politely ask for a fix.
summary: A resident reports a leak and a broken hallway light using -던데.
setting: An apartment management office (관리사무소) on a weekday morning. A resident of unit 1203 comes in to report a problem in the kitchen and in the hallway. A staff member takes the request.

task.title: Report and request repairs
task.line: Use the dialogue, the word list and -던데 (something you saw or noticed earlier + your request) to solve each item.

words.exampleMeaning: You can register your car at the management office.
Mold has appeared on the bathroom ceiling.
They say the technician will come tomorrow morning.
You must not leave bicycles in the hallway.
I replaced the broken door lock with a new one.
If you leave your number, we'll call you.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요. 1203호에 사는데요, 부탁드릴 게 있어서 왔어요.
dialogue.meaning: Hello. I live in unit 1203, and I came because I have something to ask.

dialogue.korean: 어제부터 부엌 천장에서 물이 조금씩 떨어지던데, 한번 봐 주실 수 있을까요?
dialogue.meaning: Since yesterday I've noticed water dripping a little from the kitchen ceiling. Could you take a look?

dialogue.korean: 오늘 오후에 기사님을 보내 드릴게요. 몇 시쯤 집에 계세요?
dialogue.meaning: I'll send a technician this afternoon. Around what time will you be home?

dialogue.korean: 세 시 이후에는 집에 있어요. 그리고 복도 전등이 며칠째 깜빡거리던데 그것도 확인해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll be home after three. Also, the hallway light has been flickering for a few days. Please check that too.

dialogue.korean: 12층 복도 말씀이시죠? 오늘 바로 교체해 드릴게요.
dialogue.meaning: You mean the 12th-floor hallway, right? We'll replace it today.

dialogue.korean: 여기에 동, 호수하고 연락처를 적어 주세요. 방문 전에 기사님이 먼저 전화드릴 거예요.
dialogue.meaning: Please write your building, unit number and phone number here. The technician will call you before he comes by.

exercises: Join the two sentences into one using -던데: 베란다 창문이 잘 안 닫혀요. / 좀 고쳐 주실 수 있을까요?
Put the parts in the right order to make a request: 확인해 주세요 / 지하 주차장 바닥이 / 좀 / 미끄럽던데
Choose the correct sentence. -던데 is about something you already saw: ⓐ 어제 복도에 물이 고여 있던데 좀 봐 주세요. ⓑ 내일 복도에 물이 고여 있던데 좀 봐 주세요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the word list (use the -아/어 form): 전구가 오래돼서 새것으로 ____ 주세요.
Answer in Korean based on the dialogue: 기사님은 주민의 집에 방문하기 전에 무엇을 해요?
answers: 베란다 창문이 잘 안 닫히던데 좀 고쳐 주실 수 있을까요?
지하 주차장 바닥이 미끄럽던데 좀 확인해 주세요. (또는: 지하 주차장 바닥이 좀 미끄럽던데 확인해 주세요.)
